project.description: Test support for identity storage: an in-memory version of the idn_ stores (customers, entity slots, login connections with drafts and rollback, group grants with their history) and of the sign-in lookups, with the same rules as platform-identity-jdbc; and a mock OIDC issuer (discovery document, key set, test tokens). For the apps' tests only (test scope); never on a production classpath.
